newsitem.title: SRI LANKA: Explosion rocks ship off eastern Sri Lanka.
newsitem.headline: Explosion rocks ship off eastern Sri Lanka.

text.p: An explosion rocked a ship carrying flour to the eastern Sri Lankan port of Trincomalee, military officials said on Thursday.
They said the explosion occurred early on Thursday when the ship bringing in flour from Argentina was in the outer harbour at Trincomalee, 240 km (150 miles) northeast of the capital Colombo.
It was not immediately known what had caused the blast but officials said naval boats had been sent to investigate.
On Wednesday, the Sri Lanka navy intercepted a flotilla of Liberation Tigers of Tamil Eelam (LTTE) rebel boats in waters off the eastern coast and sank seven of them.
Trincomalee is a major naval base where the rebels sank two naval boats in April 1995, ending the last round of peace talks with the government.
